entries.composition_dna: Saturated single-color field with blueprint grid + halftone corners; two large tilted white rounded cards, oversized serif numerals 01/02, gradient text panels with serif-italic myth headline + sans body; dashed connector path between cards; contact header + site footer.

Photoreal clipboard flat-lay on marble; two polaroid-style result photos labeled Week 1 / Week 2 stacked right; bold claim headline left with accent words; product bottle breaking frame bottom-left; handwritten annotations + doodle icons with arrows right margin.

Black chalk-textured canvas; massive cream condensed BEFORE top / AFTER bottom, letterforms clipped by frame; two taped polaroids — plain product shot vs vivid AI-styled shot — rotated opposing angles; handwritten white labels + sketch arrow; follow chip top-left.

Horizontal 50/50 split, two near-identical minimal panels: tool icon(s) centered top, giant two-line sans headline with the changing word wrapped in a UI text-selection highlight with drag handles; author chip bottom; contrast comes from icon row growth between panels.

Light neutral field; two overlapping tilted polaroids — left monochrome (before), right full color (after); oversized accent-color Before and After words anchored to each photo; curved arrows + small benefit captions; corner meta (company, CTA, phone, handle).

Vertical torn-paper split: left desaturated grey scene with stressed person + clutter props; right saturated brand-color scene with same person celebrating; sticker-style outlined labels on each side; shared desk/laptop bridges both halves; website/social footer.

Photoreal outdoor scene (waterfront/city); person holds a giant 3D-extruded Instagram post card; the card is a real UI mockup — header with handle, brand-color body with stacked service copy in rounded inner panel, live engagement row + caption; cracked-ground detail sells the weight; logo top.

locked: giant physical post mockup as hero

entries.composition_dna: Light studio field; giant photoreal pencil center with brand-color ribbon spiraling around it carrying service names; alternating left/right solid bars with white line icons + service labels; hashtag line + website/phone footer bar.

Tall single-color field with doodle accents; headline block top + intro line; 4-stat icon row; five alternating numbered cards (bold two-tone headlines + short body) each paired with a flat human illustration + mini UI props; dashed connectors; rocket finale.

Vertical split wall in two month colors; giant ghost numerals (outgoing faint on left, incoming bold on right); vertical month names running up each side; photoreal person mid-stride crossing the color boundary; wax-seal logo stamp + greeting block top; handle + hashtag footer.

Paper-texture light field; three hanging bulbs, two glass-clear and one brand-color lit with ray ticks; dashed flight path with paper-plane loops down to a highlight-bar headline stack (bar + bold two-tone line + kicker); hashtag line; footer bar with site + socials.
entries.intake_note: distinct from DNA_05 (orbital) — kept as separate profile

entries.composition_dna: Light grey field; large embossed 3D disc center with title; multicolor arc path around it carrying small node dots; 5 ringed satellite circles (each own hue, white core) with bold label + body text, arranged on the lower arc; logo top-right.

Dark textured field; solid brand-color circle (PAST) vs dashed outline circle (FUTURE) side by side; cross-marked claims radiate left, check-marked claims right; glowing hero object below; massive headline block with highlight-bar word; save chip top-right, footer contact pill.

entries.working_label: semicircle timeline arrow tabs over photo
entries.composition_dna: Blurred photo background; big soft-white circle left with title + body; thin arc through 5 numbered dark arrow tabs stepping down-right, each with white icon circle, title + body; numbered rings on each tab.

Paper-texture light field; donut wheel of alternating brand-color/charcoal segments, each with rotated label + thin line icon; solid center disc with topic title; oversized numeral + kicker text at the wheel gap right; floating glossy social-icon pucks around; hashtag + footer bar.

Off-white speckled art-paper field; serif headline + sub; 7 photoreal paint-swirl balls sitting in concentric ring targets, scattered organically; curved hand-written labels around each; black % flags on bent connector lines all tracing down to a monochrome hand holding them like balloons; tiny scale legend; source line bottom.

Deep brand-color field with flowing light waves; big white headline question; 3 white rounded step cards alternating left/right with glossy icon pucks, giant STEP numerals opposite each card; dotted S-path with ring nodes connecting them; follow/contact footer.

Textured off-white field; giant date numeral with photoreal worker cutouts emerging from/behind it (bag carrier, wrench hand), vertical month tag; oversized serif DAY wordmark with rotated side word + script-crossed letter; white-on-accent subline bar; faint duotone scene silhouettes at base.

Warm cream field; letterspaced two-line title (one line accent); central duotone-screened portrait of the honored figure rising from a ghost emblem circle; small label tag at shoulder; rotated photo cards fanned behind on dotted arc; solid ribbon banner with tagline below; serif+sans body line footer.

Light textured field; monochrome national monuments collage overlapping offset accent-color blocks; country map outline behind; calligraphy wordmark + script subline top-left; waving mono flag; centered italic serif greeting + date + body lines below.

locked: mono monument collage + flat color blocks

entries.composition_dna: Deep brand-color field with faint splash/product motifs; italic witty quote lines top; hero: the ocassion object SWAPPED with the profession object (keyboard wrapped in torn chocolate foil); script greeting line below; handle + icons footer.

Flat deep-red field; illustrated 3D hands opening a velvet ring box; inside sits the brand/food object instead of a ring; split headline "Will you..." top / punchline bottom in friendly rounded type; watermark top-left.

Vivid single-color studio field with soft light sweeps; giant rounded-triangle desk flip-calendar hero showing month + huge date; headline above with hand-drawn circle around key word; logo top-center.

Dark gradient field; white UI month-grid card centered, paper TORN OPEN at middle revealing accent-color core with script "It's Official" + giant date; one grid cell highlighted; bold Save The Date title above; event logo top-left, theme stamp top-right, handle footer.

White field with accent arc shapes; giant condensed "1 DAY TO GO" interlocked with numeral; oversized analog clock breaking bottom frame, event details (date/time/zone) set INSIDE the clock face; small flying motifs; logo + event badge top corners.

Cream field with faint grid; bold charcoal "Something's Brewing..." top-left; large tilted accent-color rounded card taped with translucent washi strips carrying huge date + day + "Block your date!"; dashed doodle arrow; partnership logo footer.

Warm neutral field with faint map lines; giant location-pin shape filled with mono city-landmark collage + accent pin core, landmark signboard and local props popping out; bold stacked "WE ARE COMING TO YOUR CITY!" right with accent word + city line; dashed journey path with heart loop; brown corner sweep + site footer.

Clean white field; glossy 3D numeral on draped pedestal with ribbon swirls + falling confetti right; left text stack: script "Celebrating", highlighted numeral-days chip, boxed keyword, plain sub + contact; logo top-left.

Plastic-wrap textured cream top / solid accent bottom split; stacked highlight-bar title "IT'S WINNER TIME!"; three pinned polaroids of winners with rank rosettes (1 center-raised), names below; bunting + confetti doodles; thank-you line + handle/contact pill footer.

Clean white field; giant left-aligned 3-line statement, trust words in accent color; photoreal laptop top-right + phone bottom-left both showing the SAME real landing page; thin divider + two-line service tagline; hashtag footer.

Soft cream studio field; massive tilted analog clock filling lower half, photoreal delivery rider driving ON the clock rim; layered headline (accent word + bold black + light sub); three icon-benefit chips along bottom; logo top-center.
